concepts.name: small transformer
concepts.definition: A neural network model with a small architecture.

concepts.name: self attention
concepts.definition: A mechanism for processing text sequences by attending to relevant parts.

concepts.name: text
concepts.definition: Input data in textual form.

concepts.name: backpropagation
concepts.definition: An algorithm for updating model parameters based on prediction errors.

concepts.name: predictions of the small transformer
concepts.definition: Outputs generated by the small transformer during training.

concepts.name: training
concepts.definition: The phase where the model learns from data.

concepts.name: regularization
concepts.definition: A technique applied to models to improve generalization.

concepts.name: training examples of the small transformer
concepts.definition: The specific dataset instances used to train the small transformer model.

concepts.name: quantization
concepts.definition: A technique applied after training to reduce memory requirements.

concepts.name: memory requirements of the small transformer
concepts.definition: The amount of memory needed by the small transformer model.

concepts.name: retrieval augmented generation
concepts.definition: A method allowing the use of external documents during question answering.

concepts.name: external documents
concepts.definition: Documents used to support answers in retrieval-augmented generation.

concepts.name: generalization beyond training examples
concepts.definition: The ability of a model to perform well on unseen data.

concepts.name: answering questions
concepts.definition: The task of responding to user queries.

concepts.name: use of external documents
concepts.definition: The act of utilizing documents outside the model's internal parameters.

concepts.name: attention score computation
concepts.definition: The calculation of a relevance score for each pair of tokens in the input sequence by comparing their query and key representations.

concepts.name: query and key vectors
concepts.definition: Vectors generated for each token to facilitate comparison within the attention mechanism.

concepts.name: output representation generation
concepts.definition: The resulting representation for each token formed by aggregating value vectors weighted by computed attention scores.

concepts.name: self attention standard
concepts.definition: A specific architectural implementation of self-attention that computes scores for all pairs of tokens in the input sequence.

concepts.name: query key and value vectors
concepts.definition: Vectors generated for each token representing its query, key, and value components.

concepts.name: output representation for each token
concepts.definition: The final representation for each token formed by aggregating value vectors weighted by attention scores.

concepts.name: gradients of loss function
concepts.definition: The derivatives of the loss function with respect to model parameters.

concepts.name: direction and magnitude of parameter adjustments
concepts.definition: The vector specifying how much and in which direction each parameter should change.

concepts.name: reduction of prediction error
concepts.definition: The decrease in the value of the prediction error metric.

concepts.name: improved predictions of the small transformer
concepts.definition: Enhanced accuracy or performance of the small transformer model.

concepts.name: parameter update step
concepts.definition: A single iteration of modifying model parameters using indicated adjustments.

concepts.name: dropout
concepts.definition: A method that prevents overfitting by randomly deactivating neurons during training.

concepts.name: weight decay
concepts.definition: A technique that improves generalization by penalizing large weights.

concepts.name: overfitting prevention
concepts.definition: The state or outcome where a model avoids overfitting.

concepts.name: overfitting
concepts.definition: The phenomenon where a model performs well on training data but poorly on unseen data.

concepts.name: numerical precision of model weights and activations
concepts.definition: The degree of accuracy with which model weights and activations are represented numerically.

concepts.name: total storage footprint of the model parameters
concepts.definition: The aggregate amount of storage space occupied by the model's parameters.

concepts.name: retriever component
concepts.definition: A component that searches an external document store for information relevant to a query.
